abstract: To investigate the influence of hormones on the process of cellular differentiation the growth and differentiation of a transplantable tumour, induced by inoculation of pluripotent mouse embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells have been studied in athymic nude mice and, normal and hypopituitary Snell dwarf mice. All athymic nude mice developed tumours independent of the numbers of cells inoculated. In contrast, the tumour percentage in normal Snell mice was lower, showing a dose-dependent increase of takes. In dwarfs tumour percentage was comparable with that observed in normal Snell mice. The morphological differentiation of teratocarcinomas grown in athymic nude mice, normal and dwarfed Snell mice shows derivatives of all three germ layers next to undifferentiated embryonal carcinoma cells. This suggests that the pituitary hormonal deficiencies of the dwarfs (growth hormone, thyroid stimulating hormone and prolactin) did not influence the tumour induction nor the development of the different tissues present in this type of tumour.
abstract_ja: ホルモンが細胞分化に及ぼす影響を調べるため、多能性マウス胎児性癌(EC)細胞を接種して生じる移植腫瘍の増殖と分化を、無胸腺ヌードマウス、正常およびの下垂体機能低下Snell矮小マウスで検討した。無胸腺ヌードマウスは接種細胞数によらずすべて腫瘍を形成した。一方、正常Snellマウスでは生着率が低く、接種細胞数に依存して増加した。矮小マウスの生着率は正常Snellマウスと同程度であった。ヌードマウス、正常およびSnell矮小マウスで増殖した奇形癌は、未分化な胎児性癌細胞とともに三胚葉すべての派生組織を示した。このことから、矮小マウスの下垂体ホルモン欠損(成長ホルモン、甲状腺刺激ホルモン、プロラクチン)は、腫瘍の誘導にも、腫瘍内組織の発生にも影響しないことが示唆される。
